name: Indian Head & Rainbow Falls
where: Adirondack Mountain Reserve · Keene Valley, New York
blurb: Lake Road up the Ausable valley to Rainbow Falls, and the Indian Head and Fish Hawk Cliffs ledges high over Lower Ausable Lake.
status: permit required: a free parking reservation from hikeamr.org is needed May 1 to October 31 for everyone entering the Adirondack Mountain Reserve (70 a day, no walk-ins); none needed November to April. Private land open to hikers under a state easement; no dogs.

trails.name: Indian Head and Fish Hawk Cliffs

rare: Common loon: Species of Special Concern in New York; seen on Lower Ausable Lake (NYS DEC, https://dec.ny.gov/nature/animals-fish-plants/common-loon; iNaturalist research-grade records)

Moose: extirpated from the Adirondacks in the 1800s and only recently returned (500+ in the park per DEC); photographed on Upper Ausable Lake in the reserve (Adirondack Explorer, https://www.adirondackexplorer.org/?p=2981)
